comments.html:
Hi Rin,

I’m really interested in this project and I would like to learn more about it! I’ve conducted biomedical research at Mount Sinai Hospital, Harvard Medical School and MGH. I’ve shadowed nephrologists and urologists who have had patients that have ulcers. My father has had ulcers actually. I wanted to know if we can discuss project ideas. Please let me know and feel free to email me at appasalvi@gmail.com.

Thanks.
– Appa Salvi
